notes.title: 2023-05-24(v1.0.7)
notes.content:
-Adds output device change function

-The processing method of the long note will be modified a little
- Modify the long note that is missing until it becomes dark

v1.0.6)
- Some special modes will be deleted
- The tutorial will be revamped. 
Instead of deleting the current tutorial file,
A separate tutorial window is displayed on the first run.
-"Use Note Default Color" will be added
When using the default color, Note uses the default color corresponding to the data.
- Correct errors related to upload record
- Fixes the problem of random abnormal operation when playing in special mode
- You can sort workshop items by sorting criteria from now on.
- Add Early/Late
- Errors that do not apply DSP buffer settings correctly are corrected

- Slow play is possible at less than 1x speed. However, in this case, the record cannot be registered.
- Shortcut key is slightly adjusted.
- If you add a new event in the editor, it will be initialized as a status value at the time. (ex. Background color at added point)
- Lightweight build file size.
- When creating a pbrff file, a bug in which the audio file cannot be compressed is fixed
- Retry bug will be fixed
- The UI error is corrected in the Calibration Window
- From now on, the pattern level will be showed on the result screen.
- Change Official Display to Original Display

notes.title: 2023-04-17 (v1.0.5)
notes.content:
- Existing official display will be changed to original display. The logo is attached to the original Lot Square song.
-Increase the direct miss range to 140ms ->200 ms.
-Add EASY and SPECIAL difficulty.
However, the difficulty level is not added to the existing bonds.
Only the difficulty classification has been added, and as it is now, the classification can be adjusted based on 2 chaebo per song and only some chaebo.
- Rename the Gimmick pack to Extra pack.
-If there is no normal sampling when entering the pack, the error of incorrect difficulty level will be corrected
- Errors that do not apply sink settings will be corrected

Build Updated (v1.0.4)
- Adds a hard decision mode. Note placement and game system are the same as normal mode, but only half of the decision is made.
- Added a multilingual support system. Currently, only English and Korean are supported.
- The album art of some songs will be renewed.
- Some Chaebo will be renewed.
- Radiant moment, restored will be temporarily deleted.
- Errors that do not apply music on or off in the editor will be corrected
- Fixed an error that prevented music from playing when the editor returned to the editor window after the test play ended
-Error related to skip of grain section will be corrected.
- If you return to the main screen immediately after the song starts, the phenomenon of music not interrupting is corrected.
- The editor fixes a bug in which the Altapsi sink is pushed
- In certain situations, the misrepresentation of the judgment as a mistake is corrected.
- Change difficulty notation Animations will be incorrectly printed.
- Fix errors related to long note rendering
- Fix the phenomenon of UI position changing when selecting a song in the song selection window
- Errors related to sound settings are corrected.
- The default value of the input thread isolation mode is changed to OFF.
- Correct errors that are not updating the score properly.
